## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `develop` (only release and hotfix branches target `main`)
- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat:`, `fix:`, …); it decides the next version
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tested in the Extension Development Host (`F5`) with `samples/showcase.md`
- [ ] Documentation updated, if behavior or settings changed
